sentences.text: Dan Trachtenberg is an American filmmaker and podcast host .	podcast	podcast
He directed the 2016 film 10 Cloverfield Lane .	10 Cloverfield Lane	10 Cloverfield Lane
Trachtenberg was one of three hosts of The Totally Rad Show and a former co-host of Geekdrome .	The Totally Rad Show	The Totally Rad Show	Geekdrome	Geekdrome
Both programs were hosted at Revision3 .	Revision3	Revision3

Trachtenberg is also the director of the 2011 short film Portal : No Escape , an episode of Black Mirror entitled `` Playtest '' and the director of various television commercials and public service announcements .	Black Mirror	Black Mirror	Playtest	Playtest_(Black_Mirror)
